congratulations: 🎉 You did it! {streak} days and counting!
suggestions:
📌 Git rebase — rebase a feature branch onto main, resolve a conflict, and push.
🛠️ Try: create a branch, make commits on both, then `git rebase main` from your branch.
🔗 https://www.atlassian.com/git/tutorials/rewriting-history/git-rebase

📌 JavaScript event loop — predict the output order of setTimeout, Promise, and console.log.
🛠️ Try: write 10 lines mixing sync code, setTimeout(0), and Promise.resolve().then() — guess the order before running.
🔗 https://javascript.info/event-loop

📌 HTTP caching — add Cache-Control headers to a static file server and verify with DevTools.
🛠️ Try: serve a file with `max-age=60`, reload in browser, confirm 304 vs 200 in Network tab.
🔗 https://web.dev/articles/http-cache

📌 SQL EXPLAIN — find why a query is slow and fix it with an index.
🛠️ Try: run EXPLAIN ANALYZE on a query, add an index, run again, compare cost.
🔗 https://use-the-index-luke.com/

📌 Docker multi-stage build — reduce an image from 1GB to under 200MB.
🛠️ Try: write a Dockerfile with a build stage (node:20) and a production stage (node:20-slim), compare sizes.
🔗 https://docs.docker.com/build/building/multi-stage/

📌 TypeScript generics — write a type-safe function that works with any shape.
🛠️ Try: write a `pluck<T, K extends keyof T>(obj: T, key: K): T[K]` function and test it.
🔗 https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/2/generics.html

📌 .env file management — set up dotenv with validation so missing vars fail fast.
🛠️ Try: create a config.ts that reads env vars and throws on startup if any required one is missing.
🔗 https://12factor.net/config

📌 REST error responses — implement a consistent error shape across your API.
🛠️ Try: create an error middleware that returns `{ error: { code, message, details } }` for all routes.
🔗 https://blog.postman.com/best-practices-for-api-error-handling/

📌 Git bisect — find which commit broke a test in a 50-commit range.
🛠️ Try: `git bisect start`, mark good/bad, let git find the culprit in ~6 steps.
🔗 https://git-scm.com/docs/git-bisect

📌 Flexbox layout — build a responsive nav bar without media queries.
🛠️ Try: create a header with logo left, links center, button right using only flexbox.
🔗 https://css-tricks.com/snippets/css/a-guide-to-flexbox/

📌 Shell scripting — write a deploy script that checks prerequisites before running.
🛠️ Try: write a script that checks if node, git, and docker exist, exits with a message if any is missing.
🔗 https://mywiki.wooledge.org/BashGuide

📌 JWT — decode a token manually and verify its signature.
🛠️ Try: base64-decode the header and payload of a JWT, then verify the signature with the secret using Node crypto.
🔗 https://jwt.io/introduction

📌 package-lock.json conflicts — resolve a merge conflict in lockfile correctly.
🛠️ Try: accept either side, then run `npm install` to regenerate. Verify with `npm ci`.
🔗 https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v10/configuring-npm/package-lock-json

📌 Database transactions — implement a transfer between two accounts that can't leave inconsistent state.
🛠️ Try: write BEGIN, debit, credit, COMMIT. Then simulate failure between debit and credit to see rollback.
🔗 https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/transaction-iso.html

📌 Regex — extract all URLs from a block of text.
🛠️ Try: write a regex that captures http/https URLs from a paragraph, test with 5 edge cases.
🔗 https://regexone.com/

📌 GitHub Actions — write a CI that runs lint + test on every PR.
🛠️ Try: create a workflow triggered on pull_request that runs `npm run lint && npm test`, make it fail on error.
🔗 https://docs.github.com/en/actions/quickstart

📌 Chrome DevTools Performance — find what's causing jank on a page.
🛠️ Try: record a Performance trace, identify a long task (>50ms), and fix it.
🔗 https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/performance/

📌 CORS — configure it correctly so your frontend can talk to your API.
🛠️ Try: set up an Express server that allows only your frontend origin, test with fetch from browser.
🔗 https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/CORS

📌 Promise.allSettled — fetch 5 APIs in parallel and handle partial failures gracefully.
🛠️ Try: call 5 URLs where 2 will 404, use allSettled to collect results and errors separately.
🔗 https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Promise/allSettled

📌 SSH keys — set up key-based auth and disable password login on a server.
🛠️ Try: generate ed25519 key, copy to a server with ssh-copy-id, test login without password.
🔗 https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/connecting-to-github-with-ssh

📌 Postgres partial indexes — index only the rows you query.
🛠️ Try: create an index on `status` WHERE `status = 'active'`, compare query plan with full index.
🔗 https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/indexes-partial.html

📌 Conventional commits — set up commitlint to enforce message format in your repo.
🛠️ Try: install commitlint + husky, make a bad commit, see it rejected.
🔗 https://www.conventionalcommits.org/

📌 Node.js streams — process a 1GB CSV without loading it into memory.
🛠️ Try: use createReadStream + readline to count lines in a large file, check memory with process.memoryUsage().
🔗 https://nodejs.org/api/stream.html

📌 Keyboard accessibility — make a custom dropdown navigable without a mouse.
🛠️ Try: add arrow key navigation + Enter to select + Escape to close on a div-based dropdown.
🔗 https://web.dev/articles/accessibility

📌 Rate limiting — implement a token bucket in 20 lines.
🛠️ Try: write a function that allows 10 requests per minute, returns 429 after that, resets over time.
🔗 https://blog.bytebytego.com/p/rate-limiting-fundamentals

📌 Vim — edit a config file using only keyboard shortcuts.
🛠️ Try: open a file with vim, search (/pattern), replace (:%s/old/new/g), save (:wq) — no mouse.
🔗 https://vim.rtorr.com/

📌 WebSockets — build a live counter that syncs across browser tabs.
🛠️ Try: create a WS server that broadcasts a count, open 3 tabs, click in one and see all update.
🔗 https://ably.com/topic/websockets-vs-sse

📌 Linux permissions — fix a 'permission denied' deploy script the right way.
🛠️ Try: create a script, remove execute bit, try to run it, fix with chmod +x, understand 755 vs 700.
🔗 https://linuxhandbook.com/linux-file-permissions/

📌 Closures — build a counter factory that returns increment/decrement/getValue functions.
🛠️ Try: write `createCounter(initial)` returning 3 functions that share private state. No classes.
🔗 https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Closures

📌 Healthcheck endpoints — add /health and /ready to an Express app for container orchestration.
🛠️ Try: /health returns 200 always, /ready returns 503 until DB is connected. Test with curl.
🔗 https://microservices.io/patterns/observability/health-check-api.html
